summary: Iteration 3 backend + frontend testing PASSED. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass on new endpoints (4 services with duration_minutes, public /settings, /events, admin payment-settings/gira/events CRUD, notifications queue for register + booking). Frontend: welcome screen has no logo circle (ornament + title + subtitle + Eliton d'Ajauncy + buttons only), Home shows 4 service cards with duration pills (60/90/30 min) and modality pills, Búzios image updated (not parachutes), Service detail shows 'Duração estimada' badge, booking correctly redirects to /payment/{id} which shows PIX key 'kwe.ahossum@pix.com.br', 'Copiar Chave PIX' and green 'Falar no WhatsApp'/'Enviar comprovante' buttons, Casa tab shows Giras card (Quarta-feira · 19:30 + note) and 3 event cards (Erê, Maria Padilha, Obaluaê), Profile has 'SUPORTE' section with green WhatsApp button, Admin has all 6 tabs (Agendamentos/Clientes/Horários/Serviços/Eventos/Configurações), Eventos tab shows add-event form + list, Configurações shows PIX + Giras editors.

issues: Tabs row is horizontally scrollable on 390px width — 6 tabs don't fit at once (expected on mobile). No visible scroll indicator; users may not realize Eventos/Configurações exist without scrolling right. Minor UX polish.

action_items: Optional UX polish: add a horizontal scroll hint (gradient/arrow) on the admin tabs row so users notice Eventos/Configurações exist beyond the visible area on 390px viewport.
Consider splitting /app/backend/server.py (840 lines) into routers (auth, services, bookings, admin, events, settings) as it now exceeds the 700-line guideline. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py properly excludes MongoDB _id from all responses.
Public /api/settings correctly exposes pix_key/pix_holder/support_whatsapp/gira/working_hours without auth (as spec requires).
get_settings() has a backfill mechanism ensuring old DBs still get pix_key/gira defaults on next read — nice.
Admin authorization enforced via admin_required for payment-settings, gira, events, notifications endpoints — 403 tested for user role.
Notification queue writes are non-blocking (fire-and-forget), stored with status='pending' and kind ('new_user'|'new_booking') as specified.
server.py grew to 840 lines with iteration 3 — approaching split threshold (guideline: 700).
Frontend uses testID broadly (welcome, login, register, home, service, payment, casa, profile) — good testability.
Payment gateway is MOCKED as noted in review_request: admin manually confirms via POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/confirm-payment; no live PSP call — correctly implemented.
